profile.headline: tszlau.com
profile.summary: Senior software engineer at Key Bank in the communications department, working on both inward and outward facing chat bot technologies. Former developer at The Cleveland Museum of Art who managed the marketing site, several generative artificial intelligence projects, and server-side scripts / processes. Previous experience as a data administration and lead evaluator at the Northern Ohio Recovery Association, who was responsible for digitizing intake forms, and generating reports delivered to both state and federal agencies regarding client satisfaction. Transitioned from an elementary science teacher to the tech sector in winter of 2019 after graduating from a full stack coding boot camp course at Case Western Reserve University. Hold a Bachelor of Arts in Environmental Studies from The University of Montana along with several industry recognized certificates.
